# 5GS NAS (5GMM and 5GSM): compliance register

What this is: the requirements of this area that are built and verified against running code, the typed rows recorded while building them, and coverage counts derived from the specs (verification.md §5). Requirements are in [`requirements.md`](../../requirements.md); deviations in [`deviations.md`](../deviations.md).

Specs read: TS 24.501 j80, TS 24.007 j50, TS 24.008 j50.

Row suffixes (requirements.md): -D defect in the sim, -B a choice the spec leaves open, -G declared gap, -V deviation from a "shall", -S spec contradiction and the reading chosen, -M mutant, -T T0 reading or measurement, -F a kaluza-core defect the sim found, -X retired. Verification: U unit, KAT or oracle test; F fuzz or property test; I interop; L lab; G gate row; A real-device comparison.

| KS-SM-B3 | 2026-10-16 | The UE's uplink QoS classifier (P2 Q10; TS 24.501 6.2.5.1.1.2, 9.11.4.13, Table 9.11.4.13.1; TS 23.501 5.7.1.5; src/proc/ue/qos_classifier). The session's signalled QoS rules are tried in increasing precedence value; a rule without one comes last. The first rule with a packet filter for the uplink (uplink only or bidirectional) whose every component matches gives the QFI. Local is the UE's end and remote the far end: in the uplink the source and the destination, in the downlink the other way round (the stub's UPF classifies downlink with the same code). Components: IPv4 addresses with mask and IPv6 with prefix, protocol or next header after the IPv6 extension headers, TCP/UDP/SCTP ports single and ranged (none in a later fragment), the SPI of ESP and AH, type of service or traffic class with mask, the flow label, and for Ethernet frames the MAC addresses and ranges, the outermost C-TAG and S-TAG VID and PCP/DEI (plain and extended) and the ethertype. A component the packet cannot have does not match. A packet no rule matches is not sent, counted per session (UL_UNMATCHED), with ue.qos.unmatched once. A session without signalled rules sends on its default QFI. The UE now keeps the QoS flow descriptions' 5QI too (create, delete, modify). ksim-ctl ue <sel> ps-list shows the rules, the flows and the UL packets per QFI, and ue.qos.classified tells each rule's first packet. | src/proc/ue/qos_classifier.cpp; src/proc/ue/nas_sm/sm.cpp; src/node/ue/device.cpp; tests/unit/proc QosClassifier; P2 Q10 |

The establishment request carries the 5GSM capability, RqoS set by default or as the persona's phone sent it (nas.sm_capability). The accept's or a modification's RQ timer value sets T3583 for the session: deactivated or zero revokes reflective QoS and drops the derived rules, and none given leaves the default of 1 minute. A DL packet whose SDAP header has the RQI derives a packet filter for UL direction. The filter is built for IPv4 and IPv6 TCP or UDP: remote and local address at full length, protocol, and the ports, swapped from the DL packet.
